name: salesforce
description: Salesforce CRM via Salesforce's official hosted MCP servers. Full CRUD on any SObject (contacts, accounts, leads, opportunities, cases) plus SOQL, SOSL, schema introspection, and recent-item lookup. Per-user OAuth 2.0 with PKCE — every action runs within the signed-in user's Salesforce permissions.

connection.instructions:
Salesforce uses per-user OAuth 2.0 with PKCE via an **External Client App** (not a standard Connected App).

1. In Salesforce Setup, search for **External Client Apps** and create a new app.
2. Under **OAuth Settings**, enable OAuth and set the **Callback URL** to the value shown above.
3. Grant the OAuth scopes listed below.
4. Copy the **Consumer Key** (Client ID) and generate a **Consumer Secret** (Client Secret).
5. Ask your Salesforce admin to enable the MCP servers for your org under **Setup → Hosted MCP Servers**.

When you click Connect you will be redirected to Salesforce to sign in. Every tool call runs with your own Salesforce permissions — field-level security and sharing rules apply.

fields.name: SALESFORCE_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Consumer Key (Client ID)
fields.helpText: From your Salesforce External Client App — OAuth Settings → Consumer Key.

fields.name: SALESFORCE_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: Consumer Secret (Client Secret)
fields.helpText: Generate under your External Client App → OAuth Settings → Consumer Secret. Stored encrypted, per user.

fields.name: SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL
fields.label: Salesforce Instance URL
fields.helpText: Your org's My Domain URL — found in Setup → My Domain. Must not include a trailing slash.
